description: Add outbox enqueue calls to all six domain stores (products, categories, brands, units, customers, suppliers) and add the three missing models to the backend SYNC_ENTITY_ALLOWLIST. This is the upload side of the sync engine — every local create/update/delete will now be queued and uploaded to Render on the next sync cycle.
steps: 1. Backend: open c:\xampp\htdocs\POS\backend\synchronization\model_applier.py. In SYNC_ENTITY_ALLOWLIST frozenset, add three new entries: ("products", "category"), ("products", "brand"), ("products", "unitofmeasure"). Customers ("customers", "customer") and suppliers ("suppliers", "supplier") are already present in the allowlist — confirm but do not duplicate.

2. Frontend: add helper function getAuthContext() to each store file. The function reads 'popmyc-auth-storage' from localStorage and returns { businessId, branchId }. This is the same pattern already used in useSync.ts lines 75-80. Add it as a module-level function (not inside the store factory) to each of: product.store.ts, category.store.ts, brand.store.ts, unit.store.ts, customer.store.ts, supplier.store.ts.

3. product.store.ts: Add 'import { useSyncStore } from "./sync.store";' at top. In addProduct method, after localStorage.setItem and before the final 'return newProduct', call useSyncStore.getState().enqueue({ offlineUuid: newProduct.id, appLabel: 'products', modelName: 'product', action: 'create', payload: newProduct as unknown as Record<string, unknown>, ...getAuthContext(), version: 1 }). In updateProduct, after the set() call, find the updated product from next array and enqueue with action: 'update', version: Date.now(). In deleteProduct, after the set() call, enqueue with action: 'delete', payload: { id }, version: Date.now().

4. category.store.ts: Same import. In addCategory, after persist(next) before return, enqueue with appLabel: 'products', modelName: 'category', action: 'create', version: 1. In deleteCategory, after persist(next), enqueue with action: 'delete', payload: { id }, version: Date.now(). Note: category store has no updateCategory method — skip update step.

5. brand.store.ts: Same import. In addBrand, after persist(next) before return, enqueue with appLabel: 'products', modelName: 'brand', action: 'create', version: 1. In updateBrand, after persist(next), enqueue with action: 'update', version: Date.now(). In deleteBrand, after persist(next), enqueue with action: 'delete', payload: { id }, version: Date.now().

6. unit.store.ts: Same import. In addUnit, after persist(next) before return, enqueue with appLabel: 'products', modelName: 'unitofmeasure', action: 'create', version: 1. In updateUnit, after persist(next), enqueue with action: 'update', version: Date.now(). In deleteUnit, after persist(next), enqueue with action: 'delete', payload: { id }, version: Date.now().

7. customer.store.ts: Same import. In addCustomer, after persist({ customers: next }) before return, enqueue with appLabel: 'customers', modelName: 'customer', action: 'create', version: 1. In updateCustomer, after persist(), find updated record, enqueue with action: 'update', version: Date.now(). In deleteCustomer, after persist(), enqueue with action: 'delete', payload: { id }, version: Date.now().

8. supplier.store.ts: Read the full store file first to locate the exact persist() call sites in addSupplier, updateSupplier, deleteSupplier. Add import and enqueue calls after each persist() call: appLabel: 'suppliers', modelName: 'supplier', create/update/delete pattern same as customers.

9. Commit all changes: git add frontend/src/stores/product.store.ts frontend/src/stores/category.store.ts frontend/src/stores/brand.store.ts frontend/src/stores/unit.store.ts frontend/src/stores/customer.store.ts frontend/src/stores/supplier.store.ts backend/synchronization/model_applier.py && git commit -m 'feat: enqueue products/categories/brands/units/customers/suppliers to sync outbox'
